title: DNA extraction from wheat leaf tissue
author: Benjamin Schwessinger
materials: The demonstrator will rupture your tissue using a TissueLyzer II https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/human-id-and-forensics/automation/tissuelyser-ii at 25 Hz for 1 min. Now the leaf rupture part of the protocol is complete. You will receive your frozen and crushed tubes with samples in week 2.
Discard the DNeasy Mini spin column.

steps.title: Label tubes with beads
steps.instruction: Label each 2 ml Eppendorf tube containing 2–3 steel beads with the treatment group (TG) name and research group (RG) number on both the top and the side of the tube.

steps.title: Select and cut leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Inspect plants for disease symptoms, select two representative leaves per treatment group (TG #1‑4) or the negative control (TG #5). Cut 1.5–2 cm middle leaf pieces from each leaf and combine both pieces into the correctly labelled tube.

steps.title: Freeze leaf samples
steps.instruction: Place the tube with leaf material on ice or immediately freeze it in liquid nitrogen. After all five TGs are prepared, inform the demonstrator, who will collect the tubes and freeze them in liquid nitrogen before tissue rupture.

steps.title: Prepare labeled spin‑column sets
steps.instruction: Label all provided tubes and spin columns with RG and TG. For each TG prepare: a QIAshredder spin column (pink) in a 2 ml collection tube, an extra 2 ml collection tube, two 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes, and a DNeasy Mini spin column (blue) in a 2 ml collection tube. You will have five identical sets.

steps.title: Resuspend ruptured tissue in Buffer AP1
steps.instruction: Add 400 µl Buffer AP1 to each 2 ml tube containing ruptured leaf tissue on ice and vortex to completely resuspend the tissue.

steps.title: Add RNase A and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 4 µl RNase A to each tube, vortex, then incubate for 10 min at 65 °C in a water bath or heating block, inverting the tube 2–3 times during incubation.

steps.title: Collect lysate and add Buffer P3
steps.instruction: Briefly hand‑centrifuge each tube as demonstrated to collect the contents. Add 130 µl Buffer P3, mix by inversion 10–20 times, then hand‑centrifuge again.

steps.title: Cool and incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Cool the tubes on ice for 2 min, then incubate on ice for 5 min (longer incubation does not affect the outcome).

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate to clear debris
steps.instruction: Label and balance the centrifuge, then centrifuge the lysate for 5 min at maximum speed to pellet undissolved particles.

steps.title: Pass lysate through QIAshredder
steps.instruction: Pipette 480 µl of the cleared lysate into the QIAshredder spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube, avoiding disturbance of any pellet.

steps.title: Centrifuge QIAshredder
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 min at maximum speed; keep the flow‑through in the lower collection tube.

steps.title: Transfer flow‑through to new tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µl of the flow‑through to a newly labelled 1.5 ml tube without disturbing any pellet.

steps.title: Add Buffer AW1 and bind DNA
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl Buffer AW1 to the 400 µl flow‑through, mix by pipetting, then transfer 500 µl of this mixture to a DNeasy Mini spin column (blue) placed in a 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed, discard the flow‑through into waste, and place the spin column back in the same 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Add remaining lysate to column
steps.instruction: Add the remaining ~500 µl sample onto the same DNeasy Mini spin column.

steps.title: Second wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed, discard the flow‑through, and keep the column in the collection tube.

steps.title: First Buffer AW2 wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Buffer AW2 onto the spin column (do not touch the membrane with the tip), centrifuge 1 min at maximum speed, discard the flow‑through, and tap the collection tube on a paper towel to remove residual liquid.

steps.title: Second Buffer AW2 wash
steps.instruction: Add another 500 µl Buffer AW2, centrifuge 2 min at maximum speed, discard the flow‑through, tap the tube on a paper towel, and place the column back into the same collection tube.

steps.title: Final spin to dry
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 1 min at maximum speed to remove any remaining wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Buffer AE
steps.instruction: Remove the spin column, transfer it to a new clearly labelled 1.5 ml tube, add 75 µl Buffer AE to the centre of the membrane, incubate 5 min at room temperature (15–25 °C), then centrifuge 1 min at maximum speed.

steps.title: Second elution
steps.instruction: Add another 75 µl Buffer AE, incubate 5 min at room temperature (15–25 °C), and centrifuge 1 min at maximum speed.

steps.title: Collect and store DNA
steps.instruction: Close the collection tube; you now have about 150 µl DNA in elution buffer in each of the five clearly labelled tubes. Hand the tubes to the demonstrator for storage until next week.
